name: omnibase/forge
description: Software forge for base-bundle: releases built from git tags, free and licensed downloads, a private Composer repository, a Unity registry (its documents written by omnisense/omnihub), client projects with a shared board, prepaid support hours and quotes - paid through base-bundle-market

suggest.ext-git2: Required by git/git-bundle to read repositories (releases, the project dashboard's history)
suggest.omnisense/omnitrade: ^1.2 with a provider that saves payment methods: one-click purchases from Forge Store and Forge Hub (forge.hub.payment_gateway, docs/hub.md)
suggest.omnitrade/stripe: ^1.2: Stripe as forge.hub.payment_gateway (a saved card read back when its buyer returns)
suggest.omnitrade/paypal: ^1.2: PayPal as forge.hub.payment_gateway (an approved setup turned into a saved method when its buyer returns)
suggest.symfony/http-client: Reads the pipelines' runs from GitHub Actions (Pipeline\GithubActionsSource)
suggest.symfony/yaml: The stages of a GitHub Actions run, from its workflow file's needs
